name: Fucidin Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About FUCIDIN CREAM

FUCIDIN CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

FUCIDIN CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

FUCIDIN CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying FUCIDIN CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUCIDIN CREAM
Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How FUCIDIN CREAM Works

FUCIDIN CREAM works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis (essential for the bacteria to grow) which results in its destruction thus managing its growth and spread of skin infection in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use FUCIDIN CREAM

Always apply FUCIDIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before applying the medicine. Rub the medicine gently on the skin. Avoid touching your eyes if the medicine is to be applied on the face. Wash your hands after use and recap the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: T Bact Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About T BACT OINTMENT

T-bact Ointment is a topical antibiotic used to manage certain skin infections. It may also be used to manage bacterial attack and infection of small cuts, wounds and abrasions. It contains mupirocin as an active ingredient that possesses antibacterial properties.

Mupirocin works by inhibiting the synthesis of protein found in the cell wall of bacteria thereby inhibiting the action of causative bacteria. It inhibits the growth of bacteria in lower concentration (bacteriostatic property) whereas at higher concentration, it kills the infecting bacteria (bactericidal property).

Always use T-bact Ointment as advised by your physician. It is not suitable for use in eyes and nose, in conjunction with cannulae (tube inserted in the body) and at the site of central venous cannulation. Avoid contact with eyes.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of T BACT OINTMENT

T-bact Ointment may cause a burning sensation, dryness, itching, and redness at the site of application in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you experience any such symptoms while using it.

Keep T-bact Ointment out of reach of children
Store at a temperature below 25°C away from sunlight

name: Soframycin Skin Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM

SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM is a multi-purpose antiseptic cream used in the management of bacterial skin infections. It also helps in accelerating the healing of minor cuts, wounds, acne, burns and boils. It contains a medicine called Framycetin, a powerful antibacterial agent which kills the bacteria that causes skin infections and protected burned or wounded skin from further infections.

Clean and dry the affected area. Apply a thin layer of SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM to the affected skin areas. You can cover the area with a clean bandage or dressing, if advised by your doctor. Usually, it is applied 2-3 times a day, or as prescribed by your doctor

Before applying this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any skin inflammation, pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.
uses: Skin infections
Healing of burns, wounds, acne, boils and cuts
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM
Skin infections
Healing of burns, wounds, acne, boils and cuts
mechanismOfAction:
How SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM Works

SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM contains a medicine called Framycetin which is a powerful topical antibacterial agent that starts to act within less than 1 minute. It works by killing bacteria on the skin. When applied to the skin, it stops bacteria from growing by interfering with their ability to make essential proteins. This helps prevent the spread of infection and promotes healing of skin wounds or infections.

Studies have shown that, framycetin effectively kills majority of the infection causing germs within a short period, adding value to faster recovery from skin conditions.

How to use SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM:
Gently clean and dry the affected area before applying the medicine
Apply a thin layer of SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM to the affected skin areas
You can cover the area with a clean bandage or dressing, if needed, unless directed otherwise by a doctor
Usually, it is applied 2-3 times a day, or as prescribed by your doctor
Be careful not to get the cream in your eyes or mouth. If this happens, rinse thoroughly with water

Always follow your doctor's instructions for the best results.
sideEffects: Skin irritation, redness, itching or burning sensation at the site of application.
Sensitivity to sunlight
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM

This medicine is generally well-tolerated, but like all medications, it may cause some side effects.

Common side effects of SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM includes:
Skin irritation, redness, itching or burning sensation at the site of application.
Sensitivity to sunlight

If any severe reactions or symptoms persist, it's important to stop using the medicine and consult a doctor.

warnings.details: Studies have shown that, topical usage of framycetin may affect the growing baby in pregnant women. Therefore, before using SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM talk to your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
It is not known whether this medicine may affect your developing baby if you use while breast feeding your baby. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
Do not use this medicine if you are allergic to framycetin.
SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM can be applied to children if prescribed by the physician.
SOFRAMYCIN SKIN CREAM can be used in elderly patients if prescribed by the physician.

Others

Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any other skin inflammatory conditions as a precaution

More Information

Bacterial skin infections, cuts, and wounds occur when harmful bacteria enter the skin through breaks or damaged areas. Common bacterial skin infections include conditions like impetigo, cellulitis, and infected wounds. Cuts and wounds can become infected if not properly cleaned and treated.

Management tips:

Clean the area: Gently wash with mild soap and water to remove dirt and bacteria.
Apply an antibiotic ointment: Use creams like Soframycin to help prevent infection.
Keep it covered: Protect the wound with a clean bandage to keep it from getting dirty.
Watch for signs of infection: Redness, swelling, pus, or worsening pain may indicate an infection, and medical attention may be needed.

Proper wound care is essential to prevent infection and promote healing.

name: MUPICIP Ointment 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About MUPICIP OINTMENT

MUPICIP OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPICIP OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPICIP OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPICIP OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPICIP OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SOFRAMAX CREAM

SOFRAMAX CREAM contains Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is indicated for wounds, burns, scalds, cuts, boils, impetigo, furunculosis, sycosis barbae, otitis externa, paronychia, secondary infections and other infective skin diseases.

Impetigo is a minor infection that can affect any part of the body mostly affecting exposed skin, such as the area around the nose and mouth, as well as the arms and legs. Furunculosis is a deep infection of the hair follicle leading to abscess formation with an accumulation of pus and necrotic tissue.

Before applying SOFRAMAX CREAM, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, deep or large puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns.

Tell your physician if you are pregnant or planning for pregnancy or breastfeeding before applying SOFRAMAX CREAM.

SOFRAMAX CREAM should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying. Contact your physician if you get any allergic reactions such as irritation, burning, redness, rashes or itching.

Introduction About NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT

 

NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT is a combination of Bacitracin, Neomycin, and Polymyxin B, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is indicated for conditions such as prophylaxis in graft donor sites, the suturing of lacerations, accidental cuts, scratches, and abrasions, managing infected ulcers, accidental cuts, scratches, abrasions, and superficial skin infections following surgical procedures and minor burns, impetigo and secondarily infected skin conditions, managing susceptible bacterial infections of the eye and its adnexa, including conjunctivitis, keratitis, infected corneal ulcer, ulcerative blepharitis with associated conjunctivitis, and chronic dacryocystitis, used pre- and postoperatively to manage ocular infection following surgical procedures, including removal of foreign bodies from the eye.

Apply a thin layer of NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT on the affected area after the removal of debris, pus, and crusts from the wound. Do not continue NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT more than seven days without medical advice. NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients allergic to antibiotics and nerve deafness. NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease.

NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. The most common side effects are skin redness and dryness (application site reactions). Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT Works

NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT works by managing bacterial growth. The three components present in NEOSPORIN SKIN OINTMENT actively work by managing the bacterial growth by blocking the enzymes and substances required for its growth. Bacitracin breaks the peptidoglycan chain needed for cell growth. Neomycin binds with proteins required for cell growth, which leads to the production of defective cell membranes. Polymyxin B damages the bacterial cell membrane, which causes leakage of cell components.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOBETAMIL G CREAM

CLOBETAMIL G CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol and Gentamicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage bacterial infections and inflammations of the skin.

During the management your doctor might regularly examine your skin to avoid any untoward side effects.

Avoid smoking while using CLOBETAMIL G CREAM. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

CLOBETAMIL G CREAM is not recommended for use in children (ages less than 1 year). Before using CLOBETAMIL G CREAM, inform your doctor if you have skin conditions like fungal infections, severe flushing on and around your nose, spotty red rash around your mouth, infected or itchy skin around the genitals.

CLOBETAMIL G CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women. CLOBETAMIL G CREAM is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of using CLOBETAMIL G CREAM are burning, pain, irritation or itching where the medicine is applied. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage bacterial skin infections

Used to manage bacterial skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOBETAMIL G CREAM Works

CLOBETAMIL G CREAM manages affected skin where Clobetasol induces certain proteins (lipocortins), that control the production of inflammatory mediators like prostaglandins and leukotrienes, thus reducing inflammation, and Gentamicin binds to 30s ribosomal subunit, disrupting mRNA translation, resulting in the formation of shortened or non-functional proteins.

introduction:
Introduction About FUSIWAL CREAM

FUSIWAL CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

FUSIWAL CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

FUSIWAL CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying FUSIWAL CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:

Avoid touching your eyes if the medicine is to be applied on the face. Wash your hands after use and recap the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPIROCIN OINTMENT

SUPIROCIN OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. SUPIROCIN OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying SUPIROCIN OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

SUPIROCIN OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of SUPIROCIN OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: Crixan Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL)

CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) contains Clarithromycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Macrolide Antibiotics. It is used to manage acne vulgaris. It also manages blackheads, whiteheads, more severe forms of acne.

Acne is caused due to blockage and the inflammation of the skin pores or hair follicles. When oil is trapped in the hair follicles, the normal skin bacteria P.acnes (gram-positive commensal bacterium) will grow in the blocked pore. The bacteria produce chemicals that alter the composition of the oil, which makes it more irritating to the skin and causes inflammation of the skin pore. This results in superficial skin eruptions.

CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) is not recommended for patients who are allergic (hypersensitive) to clarithromycin, or to any other ingredients present in it.

This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers. Consult your doctor before using CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL).

The most common side effects include skin dryness and possible irritation. Consult a doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage pimples, blackheads, whiteheads and more severe forms of acne

Manage pimples, blackheads, whiteheads and more severe forms of acne
mechanismOfAction:
How CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) Works

CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) manages the growth of bacteria by interfering with its protein synthesis and binds specific proteins present in the bacterial ribosomes, thus stopping the growth of the bacteria inside the body, which helps to reduce the infection and its symptoms.

Always use CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of CRIXAN 1/ GEL(TOPICAL) to the affected area. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MUPIZER OINTMENT

MUPIZER OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPIZER OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPIZER OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPIZER OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPIZER OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How MUPIZER OINTMENT Works

MUPIZER OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.

How to use MUPIZER OINTMENT

Apply MUPIZER OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: Fourderm Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About FOURDERM CREAM

FOURDERM CREAM is a combination of Chlorhexidine gluconate, Clobetasol propionate, Miconazole nitrate, and Neomycin sulphate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiseptic antibacterial agents, Topical corticosteroids, Antifungals, and Aminoglycoside antibiotics, respectively. FOURDERM CREAM is used to manage corticosteroid -responsive dermatoses (skin conditions that occurs due to corticosteroid medications), eczema (skin inflammation), and psoriasis (itchy dry skin) in affected individuals.

FOURDERM CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to chlorhexidine gluconate, clobetasol propionate. miconazole nitrate, and/or neomycin sulphate. It is also not recommended for use in patients scheduled for brain/spinal cord/middle ear operation, and in patients suffering from skin problems (such as acne, rosacea, itching around anus/genitals).

Before applying FOURDERM CREAM, inform your doctor if you had previous bone symptoms (such as bone pain), previous allergic reaction with another steroid, broken/damaged skin, chronic leg ulcer, and/or psoriasis.

FOURDERM CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of applying FOURDERM CREAM are burning, pain, irritation, and/or itching sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses, eczema and psoriasis in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of FOURDERM CREAM
Manage corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses, eczema and psoriasis in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How FOURDERM CREAM Works

FOURDERM CREAM provides relief from corticosteroid -responsive dermatoses, eczema. and psoriasis, where Chlorhexidine gluconate kills microorganisms by binding strongly with skin and managing their growth, Clobetasol propionate manages occurrence of swelling, redness & itchy skin (inflammatory reaction) by blocking the production of prostaglandins (chemical messengers responsible for inflammation), Miconazole manages fungal infection by managing the fungus from forming their own protective covering (thus resulting in their destruction) and Neomycin manages bacterial infections by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis which results in bacterial cell destruction thus managing corticosteroid -responsive dermatoses, eczema. and psoriasis in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use FOURDERM CREAM

Always apply FOURDERM CREAM, as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. On the affected area, apply a thin layer of this medicine. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster/bandage. Do not apply FOURDERM CREAM on your face beyond 5 days. Avoid applying FOURDERM CREAM around your eyes, including eyelids. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

FOURDERM CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.
FOURDERM CREAM is not recommended for use if you are allergic to chlorhexidine gluconate, clobetasol propionate, miconazole nitrate, neomycin sulphate, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

FOURDERM CREAM is not recommended for use if you:

Are scheduled for brain/spinal cord/middle ear operation
Have skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin on and around your nose), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around your mouth), itching around anus /genitals, infected/itchy skin, and/or widespread plaque psoriasis

Before applying FOURDERM CREAM, inform your doctor if you:

Had a history of bone symptoms such as bone pain, swelling, and/or tenderness near the affected area
Had previously suffered from an allergic reaction with another steroid
Are planning to apply the medicine under an airtight dressing including a child’s nappy
Have broken/damaged skin/skin folds
Have a large surface area to apply the medicine
Have psoriasis (itchy skin)
Suffer from chronic leg ulcer
Have the site of application as face, open wound, dry, chapped, irritated/sun-burned skin

Use in Pediatrics:

FOURDERM CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged below 1 year). It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 2 to 18 years).  Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

FOURDERM CREAM should be applied with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before applying FOURDERM CREAM.

introduction:
Introduction About ORNIGREAT GEL

ORNIGREAT GEL contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage periodontal disease (periodontitis), gingivitis (gum inflammation), aphthous stomatitis (sore or ulcers in the mouth or gums). Periodontal disease is a condition that affects the supporting structure of teeth leading to the formation of pockets due to which tooth loss occurs.

Ornidazole is an antiprotozoal that kills parasites and bacteria that live in the absence of oxygen by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria.

ORNIGREAT GEL should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effect of using ORNIGREAT GEL is application site irritation. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TERABET GM CREAM

TERABET GM CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol, Miconazole and Neomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals and Antibiotics. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infection.

TERABET GM CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, perianal and genital pruritus, viral infections (ex. herpes simplex, chickenpox) and perforated eardrum. Contact your doctor before applying. TERABET GM CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease. Contact your doctor before applying.

TERABET GM CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. TERABET GM CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying. TERABET GM CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

Dosage adjustment is not required for TERABET GM CREAM in the geriatric population. However, greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, itching, redness, burning sensation and contact dermatitis. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infection
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERABET GM CREAM
Used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary bacterial or fungal infection
mechanismOfAction:
How TERABET GM CREAM Works

TERABET GM CREAM helps to manage infection, where Clobetasol have anti-inflammatory, antipruritic, and vasoconstrictive properties, which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Miconazole belongs to antifungal which stops the growth of fungi while Neomycin belongs to antibiotic which stops the growth of bacteria in the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use TERABET GM CREAM

Apply TERABET GM CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Avoid contact with eyes, face, groin or in the skin folds.

S CLEAR CREAM contains Ozenoxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage topical impetigo in adults and children aged 2 months and above.

Impetigo is a superficial skin infection mainly affects the infants and children. Symptoms include red sores on the face, nose, mouth or on the arms and legs.

Before applying S CLEAR CREAM, inform your doctor if you have bacterial or fungal infections, contact dermatitis. Consult your doctor for advice.

There is no information on the use of the S CLEAR CREAM in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before applying. S CLEAR CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

S CLEAR CREAM should be used with caution in children aged 2 months to 17 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

S CLEAR CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of this medicine are irritation and itching at the application site, rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis. Contact your physician if the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About T MUCE OINTMENT

T MUCE OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. T MUCE OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying T MUCE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

T MUCE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of T MUCE OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Ceoderm Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CEODERM CREAM

CEODERM CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

CEODERM CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of CEODERM CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use CEODERM CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using CEODERM CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using CEODERM CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying CEODERM CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.

Skin infections (Fungal and Bacterial origin)

mechanismOfAction:
How CEODERM CREAM Works

CEODERM CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CEODERM CREAM

Apply a small amount of CEODERM CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse CEODERM CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of CEODERM CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.

name: T MUCE Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About T MUCE OINTMENT

T MUCE OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. T MUCE OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying T MUCE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

T MUCE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of T MUCE OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis, impetigo and furunculosis
Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin

Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
mechanismOfAction:
How T MUCE OINTMENT Works

T MUCE OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.
usageDetails:
How to use T MUCE OINTMENT

Apply T MUCE OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FUSIVAC CREAM

FUSIVAC CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

FUSIVAC CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

FUSIVAC CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying FUSIVAC CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPINASE OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPINASE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPINASE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPINASE OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT

METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT is a combination of Metronidazole and Povidone Iodine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals and Topical Antiseptic agents respectively. It is used to manage infections such as cuts, abrasions, post-surgical procedures dressing, burns, infected wounds and diabetic foot ulcers.

Apply METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT gently on the surface of the wound after cleaning as directed by your physician. Before using METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT inform your doctor if you have any allergic or hypersensitivity reactions. There are limited information available on the use of METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

Caution must be exercised while using METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using METROGYL P 2% OINTMENT are local swelling, irritation, itching and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About SOFINOX CREAM

SOFINOX CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

SOFINOX CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

SOFINOX CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SOFINOX CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MUPINEXT Ointment 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About MUPINEXT OINTMENT

MUPINEXT OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPINEXT OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPINEXT OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPINEXT OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPINEXT OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis, impetigo and furunculosis
Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
usesDetails:

Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
mechanismOfAction:
How MUPINEXT OINTMENT Works

MUPINEXT OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.
usageDetails:
How to use MUPINEXT OINTMENT

Apply MUPINEXT OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SOFINOX CREAM

SOFINOX CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

SOFINOX CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

SOFINOX CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SOFINOX CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About XEPINOXIN CREAM

XEPINOXIN CREAM contains Ozenoxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage topical impetigo in adults and children aged 2 months and above.

Impetigo is a superficial skin infection mainly affects the infants and children. Symptoms include red sores on the face, nose, mouth or on the arms and legs.

Before applying XEPINOXIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have bacterial or fungal infections, contact dermatitis. Consult your doctor for advice.

There is no information on the use of the XEPINOXIN CREAM in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before applying. XEPINOXIN CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

XEPINOXIN CREAM should be used with caution in children aged 2 months to 17 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

XEPINOXIN CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of this medicine are irritation and itching at the application site, rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis. Contact your physician if the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage impetigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of XEPINOXIN CREAM
Used to manage impetigo
mechanismOfAction:
How XEPINOXIN CREAM Works

XEPINOXIN CREAM works by inhibiting the bacterial DNA replication enzymes and manages the bacteria from multiplying, thereby works against the bacteria and reduces the skin infection.
usageDetails:
How to use XEPINOXIN CREAM

Apply XEPINOXIN CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
sideEffects: Application site reactions (irritation and itching)
Rosacea (a skin condition causing flushing of the face)
Seborrheic dermatitis (a skin condition causing scaly patches and red skin on scalp)
Allergic reaction or severe local irritation

name: Sofinox Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About SOFINOX CREAM

SOFINOX CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

SOFINOX CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

SOFINOX CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SOFINOX CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOFINOX CREAM
Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How SOFINOX CREAM Works

SOFINOX CREAM works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis (essential for the bacteria to grow) which results in its destruction thus managing its growth and spread of skin infection in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use SOFINOX CREAM

Always apply SOFINOX CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before applying the medicine. Rub the medicine gently on the skin. Avoid touching your eyes if the medicine is to be applied on the face. Wash your hands after use and recap the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: HALOTOP F Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About HALOTOP F CREAM

HALOTOP F CREAM is a combination of Fusidic acid and Halobetasol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics and Topical Corticosteroids respectively. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections, eczema, seborrhoeic & contact dermatitis, psoriasis and infected dermatoses.

Atopic dermatitis (eczema) is a condition that causes dry, itchy and inflamed skin. Psoriasis is a skin disease that causes a rash with itchy, scaly patches, most commonly on the knees, elbows, trunk and scalp. Infectious dermatoses that can manifest as vesicles include bacteria, viruses, fungi, syphilis and other infections.

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, consult your doctor before using this medicine. The most common side effect of this medicine is application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness). Consult your doctor if the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How HALOTOP F CREAM Works

HALOTOP F CREAM is a combination of Halobetasol and Fusidic acid. Halobetasol is a steroid that blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Fusidic Acid is an antibiotic that works against bacteria by managing the synthesis of essential proteins required by bacteria to carry out vital functions.
usageDetails:
How to use HALOTOP F CREAM

Apply HALOTOP F CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Do not use this medicine on your face for more than 5 days. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids.

name: Mupimet Ointment 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About MUPIMET OINTMENT

MUPIMET OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPIMET OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPIMET OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPIMET OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPIMET OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis, impetigo and furunculosis
Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of MUPIMET OINTMENT

mechanismOfAction:
How MUPIMET OINTMENT Works

MUPIMET OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.
usageDetails:
How to use MUPIMET OINTMENT

Apply MUPIMET OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: CO Mupimet Collagen Particles 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About CO MUPIMET GRANULES

CO MUPIMET GRANULES is a combination of Mupirocin and Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It helps to manage chronic wounds and manages the bacterial infections. It is also helps to manage chronic tunnel wounds, bed sores and diabetic foot ulcers.

Bacterial skin infections develop when bacteria enter through hair follicles, small breaks in the skin that result from scrapes, punctures, surgery, burns, sunburn, animal or insect bites, wounds and pre-existing skin disorders.

Before applying CO MUPIMET GRANULES inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, nervous system problems, bleeding disorder, open wounds or damaged skin.

Before applying CO MUPIMET GRANULES inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

CO MUPIMET GRANULES should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of applying CO MUPIMET GRANULES are burning sensation, itching, redness, irritation at the application site. Consult your doctor if the above side effects does not improve.
uses: Manage chronic wounds, bed sores and diabetic foot ulcers
Prevent bacterial infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of CO MUPIMET GRANULES

It is used to:

Manage chronic wounds, bed sores and diabetic foot ulcers
Prevent bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CO MUPIMET GRANULES Works

CO MUPIMET GRANULES works against the bacteria and promoting faster healing of the infection in which mupirocin exerts its action by reversibly binding to an enzyme (isoleucyl transfer RNA synthetase) and inhibits its activity of synthesis of proteins in the bacteria and produce microbicidal action. Metronidazole destroys the bacteria and other microorganisms that cause infections by damaging the DNA.

introduction:
Introduction About FUSIWAL B CREAM

FUSIWAL B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage specific skin infections caused by typical bacteria such as impetigo, folliculitis, eczema and seborrehic dermatitis.

Impetigo is a skin infection that causes blisters or sores on the face, neck, hands and diaper area. Folliculitis is a common skin condition that happens when hair follicles become inflamed.

Seborrehic dermatitis is a skin condition that causes scaly patches and red skin, mainly on the scalp. Atopic dermatitis (eczema) is a condition that causes dry, itchy and inflamed skin. It is common in young children but can occur at any age.

Do not apply FUSIWAL B CREAM on your eyes or face. Avoid using FUSIWAL B CREAM for a long time. Do not use FUSIWAL B CREAM under bandages.

FUSIWAL B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Beclomethasone or Fusidic acid.

FUSIWAL B CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with other skin infections caused by bacteria or virus.

Avoid concomitant use of other topical medicines and steroids while on management with FUSIWAL B CREAM.

It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before using FUSIWAL B CREAM. It should be used with caution in children above 6 years of age.

FUSIWAL B CREAM should be used with caution in elder patients. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of FUSIWAL B CREAM are itching, skin rash, stretch marks, skin discoloration and thinning of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FUSIWAL B CREAM Works

FUSIWAL B CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Fusidic acid. Beclomethasone belongs to corticosteroid which works by reducing the inflammation and relieves symptoms like itching, redness, irritation and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Fusidic acid manages the further growth of bacteria rather than directly destroying the bacteria. It also works by blocking protein synthesis of the bacteria. Thus, destroying the bacterial growth and further spreading of infection.

Apply FUSIWAL B CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub gently on the affected area. Do not use FUSIWAL B CREAM on your face or eyes. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About NADITRET PLUS CREAM

NADITRET PLUS CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals, Corticosteroids and Antibiotic respectively. It is used to manage bacterial and fungal skin infections like atopic and contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme, infective eczema, psoriasis and skin lesions.

Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enters the body, increase the number of bacteria and cause a reaction in the body. A fungal infection (mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person. Before using NADITRET PLUS CREAM, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis. NADITRET PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use during pregnancy.

NADITRET PLUS CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. NADITRET PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions (such as burning, irritation, itching, flaking and redness). Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NADITRET PLUS CREAM Works

NADITRET PLUS CREAM is a combination of Miconazole, Mometasone and Nadifloxacin. Miconazole works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungi and works against fungi. Mometasone is a corticosteroid that works by blocking the various chemical messengers (like histamine) involved in allergic and non-allergic mediated inflammation. It reduces inflammation, itchiness and redness by managing the traveling of infection-fighting white blood cells (WBCs) to the affected area of the body. Nadifloxacin belongs to antibiotic works by against the bacteria that cause skin infections and also inhibits the repairing of bacterial cells, thereby managing the further spread of the infections.

Apply NADITRET PLUS CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

FUSIWAL CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

FUSIWAL CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying FUSIWAL CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MUPIMET OINTMENT

MUPIMET OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUPIMET OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUPIMET OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUPIMET OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUPIMET OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How MUPIMET OINTMENT Works

MUPIMET OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.

How to use MUPIMET OINTMENT

Apply MUPIMET OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: OZEFIT Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About OZEFIT CREAM

OZEFIT CREAM contains Ozenoxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage topical impetigo in adults and children aged 2 months and above.

Impetigo is a superficial skin infection mainly affects the infants and children. Symptoms include red sores on the face, nose, mouth or on the arms and legs.

Before applying OZEFIT CREAM, inform your doctor if you have bacterial or fungal infections, contact dermatitis. Consult your doctor for advice.

There is no information on the use of the OZEFIT CREAM in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before applying. OZEFIT CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

name: Niogenta F Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About NIOGENTA F CREAM

NIOGENTA F CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage specific skin infections caused by typical bacteria such as impetigo, folliculitis, eczema and seborrehic dermatitis.

Impetigo is a skin infection that causes blisters or sores on the face, neck, hands and diaper area. Folliculitis is a common skin condition that happens when hair follicles become inflamed.

Seborrehic dermatitis is a skin condition that causes scaly patches and red skin, mainly on the scalp. Atopic dermatitis (eczema) is a condition that causes dry, itchy and inflamed skin. It is common in young children but can occur at any age.

Do not apply NIOGENTA F CREAM on your eyes or face. Avoid using NIOGENTA F CREAM for a long time. Do not use NIOGENTA F CREAM under bandages.

NIOGENTA F CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Beclomethasone or Fusidic acid.

NIOGENTA F CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with other skin infections caused by bacteria or virus.

Avoid concomitant use of other topical medicines and steroids while on management with NIOGENTA F CREAM.

It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before using NIOGENTA F CREAM. It should be used with caution in children above 6 years of age.

NIOGENTA F CREAM should be used with caution in elder patients. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of NIOGENTA F CREAM are itching, skin rash, stretch marks, skin discoloration and thinning of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How NIOGENTA F CREAM Works

NIOGENTA F CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone and Fusidic acid. Beclomethasone belongs to corticosteroid which works by reducing the inflammation and relieves symptoms like itching, redness, irritation and swelling by blocking the enzymes responsible for causing it (prostaglandins and leukotrienes). Fusidic acid manages the further growth of bacteria rather than directly destroying the bacteria. It also works by blocking protein synthesis of the bacteria. Thus, destroying the bacterial growth and further spreading of infection.

Apply NIOGENTA F CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area and rub gently on the affected area. Do not use NIOGENTA F CREAM on your face or eyes. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: METNIZID DG Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About METNIZID DG GEL

METNIZID DG GEL is a combination of Chlorhexidine and Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobial agents. It is used to manage skin inflammation caused due to skin infections, rosacea, minor burns and scalds, sunburn, scratches or abrasions. It can also be used to manage skin infections.

Apply a thin layer of METNIZID DG GEL on the affected areas. Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. METNIZID DG GEL should be used on the face only if instructed by the physician. Avoid exposing the managed skin areas towards direct sun light or other light sources.

Before using METNIZID DG GEL inform your doctor if you have any blood problems or any upcoming surgery on your brain, spinal cord or ears. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of using this medicine are skin dryness, redness, mild irritation, itching or burning sensation and metallic taste in mouth. Consult your doctor of any of these side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How METNIZID DG GEL Works

METNIZID DG GEL is an antiseptic agent with antibacterial properties. It kills the susceptible bacteria that causes inflammation and infection. When applied topically on the skin, it destroys the infection causing germs and manages their further growth and multiplication which therefore reduces skin infections and inflammatory skin lesions.
usageDetails:
How to use METNIZID DG GEL

Apply a thin layer of METNIZID DG GEL on the affected skin areas or as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Use this medicine on your face only if instructed by your doctor.

Avoid contact of this medicine with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose and with open wounds. Do not cover the application site with bandages, dressings or clothes unless your doctor tells you to do so.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not use METNIZID DG GEL for more than the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About M SYS OINTMENT

M SYS OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. M SYS OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying M SYS OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

M SYS OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of M SYS OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: SUPIROCIN Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About SUPIROCIN CREAM

Supirocin Cream is an Antibiotic cream used manage certain bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (small scratch or itchy patch of eczema), folliculitis (skin swelling around the hair roots) and boils. It contains Mupirocin as an active ingredient that helps in eliminating bacterial colonies.

Mupirocin exhibits strong antimicrobial activity by inhibiting the activity of certain transfer RNA which help in synthesis of bacterial proteins and RNA, thereby minimizing the ability of bacteria to survive.

Always use Supirocin Cream exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Apply Supirocin Cream on the infected area of the skin as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended usage.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOVIVA M CREAM

CLOVIVA M CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals. It is used to manage resistant dermatoses (skin infections) with secondary fungal infections like psoriasis (except widespread plaque psoriasis) and recalcitrant dermatoses.

CLOVIVA M CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with rosacea, acne vulgaris, perioral dermatitis, pruritus without inflammation, perianal and genital pruritus. CLOVIVA M CREAM should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney disease and psoriasis. Contact your doctor before applying.

Use of CLOVIVA M CREAM during pregnancy should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the foetus. Contact your doctor before applying. Use of CLOVIVA M CREAM during lactation should only be considered if the expected benefit to the mother outweighs the risk to the infant. Contact your doctor before applying.

CLOVIVA M CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age and should be used with caution in children above 1 year of age. Contact your doctor before applying. CLOVIVA M CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients. Contact your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of this medicine are pruritus, skin burning or skin pain. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Nadoxin C Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About NADOXIN C CREAM

NADOXIN C CREAM is a combination of Clobetasol propionate and Nadifloxacin which belong to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Fluoroquinolones, respectively. NADOXIN C CREAM is used to manage contact dermatitis, erythema multiforme and infective eczema.

Contact dermatitis is a condition characterised by an itchy rash that occurs due to direct contact with a substance or an allergic reaction to it. Erythema multiforme is a skin disorder that occurs due to an allergic reaction to a medicine or an infection and is generally characterised by symptoms such as sudden, red patches and blisters on the face, hands and soles of feet, itching and cold sores.

Infective eczema is a chronic skin condition that cracks, dries, inflames and irritates the skin, leading to a bacterial or viral infection that is generally characterised by symptoms such as fever, weakness and swollen lymph nodes.

NADOXIN C CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with skin problems such as acne (pimples) or rosacea (severe flushing of the skin on and around your nose) or perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around your mouth), itchy skin, skin infection, itching around the anus or vagina and widespread plaque psoriasis (itchy skin disease).

Before applying NADOXIN C CREAM, inform your doctor if you smoke, have broken or damaged skin, have a large site of application, have psoriasis (itchy skin), have a chronic leg ulcer or have thin skin (as a site of application). NADOXIN C CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and is not recommended for use when applied to the breasts while feeding a baby.

NADOXIN C CREAM is also not recommended for use in children (below 1 year) and should be used with caution in children (over 1 year) and adolescents (below 18 years). The most common symptoms of applying NADOXIN C CREAM are burning, pain, irritation or itching sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About T BACT CREAM

T BACT CREAM contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. T BACT CREAM should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying T BACT CREAM, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

T BACT CREAM is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of T BACT CREAM are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SUDIF CREAM

SUDIF CREAM contains fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of bacterial skin infections such as impetigo (crusty patchy skin), infected dermatitis (inflamed skin with spots), infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals.

SUDIF CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to fusidic acid.

SUDIF CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women which is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying SUDIF CREAM are feeling pain, and/or burning sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUDIF CREAM
Manage bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, infected cuts, and grazes in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How SUDIF CREAM Works

SUDIF CREAM works by inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis (essential for the bacteria to grow) which results in its destruction thus managing its growth and spread of skin infection in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use SUDIF CREAM

Always apply SUDIF CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before applying the medicine. Rub the medicine gently on the skin. Avoid touching your eyes if the medicine is to be applied on the face. Wash your hands after use and recap the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MICOBREX Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About MICOBREX GEL

MICOBREX GEL contains Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicine called Antifungals agents. It is used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails.

Skin infections may appear on the trunk, hands or feet, scalp or outer ear, groin and include athlete’s foot, dhobie itch and intertrigo. It is also effective against infected nappy rash. It also has moisturising properties to help soothe cracked, red skin.

Skin infections will usually get better after 2 to 6 weeks. If your condition does not improve after 2 to 6 weeks of management, consult your doctor for advice.

This medicine can be used for adults and children. Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

Before using MICOBREX GEL tell your doctor if you have ever had kidney disease, heart disease or liver problem. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using MICOBREX GEL include burning sensation, irritation, itching, and redness at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage fungal and associated bacterial infections of the skin and nails

mechanismOfAction:
How MICOBREX GEL Works

MICOBREX GEL works by destroying the fungus that causes the infection and some of the associated bacteria which may also be present.

How to use MICOBREX GEL

Use MICOBREX GEL exactly as your doctor has told you. It is for external use only. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: MUDERMA Ointment 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About MUDERMA OINTMENT

MUDERMA OINTMENT contains Mupirocin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial agents. It is used to manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis (swelling of the skin around the hair roots), impetigo (appears as a small scratch or itchy patch of eczema) and furunculosis (pus-filled bump under the skin caused by infected and inflamed hair follicles).

It can also be used to manage skin infections due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds, or scraped skin. MUDERMA OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Before applying MUDERMA OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

MUDERMA OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children (aged under 1 year) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects associated with the use of MUDERMA OINTMENT are application site reactions such as itching, redness, burning, rash, swelling, and pain in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis, impetigo and furunculosis
Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
usesDetails:
Uses Of MUDERMA OINTMENT
Manage bacterial skin infections such as folliculitis, impetigo and furunculosis
Manage infections on the skin due to small cuts, lacerations, wounds or on scraped skin
mechanismOfAction:
How MUDERMA OINTMENT Works

MUDERMA OINTMENT works by killing the bacteria that cause skin infections by managing the synthesis of essential proteins necessary for the survival of bacteria. Thereby, managing the skin infection from spreading.
usageDetails:
How to use MUDERMA OINTMENT

Apply MUDERMA OINTMENT as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying for the medicine. Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently. You can cover the managed area with a plaster or other suitable dressing if advised by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct frequency and duration for you depending on your age and disease condition.

name: METNIZID P Ointment 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About METNIZID P OINTMENT

METNIZID P OINTMENT is a combination of Metronidazole and Povidone Iodine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals and Topical Antiseptic agents respectively. It is used to manage infections such as cuts, abrasions, post-surgical procedures dressing, burns, infected wounds and diabetic foot ulcers.

Apply METNIZID P OINTMENT gently on the surface of the wound after cleaning as directed by your physician. Before using METNIZID P OINTMENT inform your doctor if you have any allergic or hypersensitivity reactions. There are limited information available on the use of METNIZID P OINTMENT in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine.

Caution must be exercised while using METNIZID P OINTMENT in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using METNIZID P OINTMENT are local swelling, irritation, itching and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About OZEFIT CREAM

OZEFIT CREAM contains Ozenoxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage topical impetigo in adults and children aged 2 months and above.

Impetigo is a superficial skin infection mainly affects the infants and children. Symptoms include red sores on the face, nose, mouth or on the arms and legs.

Before applying OZEFIT CREAM, inform your doctor if you have bacterial or fungal infections, contact dermatitis. Consult your doctor for advice.

There is no information on the use of the OZEFIT CREAM in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before applying. OZEFIT CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

OZEFIT CREAM should be used with caution in children aged 2 months to 17 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

OZEFIT CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of this medicine are irritation and itching at the application site, rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis. Contact your physician if the side effects worsen.
uses: Used to manage impetigo
usesDetails:

Used to manage impetigo
mechanismOfAction:
How OZEFIT CREAM Works

OZEFIT CREAM works by inhibiting the bacterial DNA replication enzymes and manages the bacteria from multiplying, thereby works against the bacteria and reduces the skin infection.
usageDetails:
How to use OZEFIT CREAM

Apply OZEFIT CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
